sloka: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलो मांसशोणितकर्दमः ।रक्षसां वानराणां च सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमः ।। ६.४२.४७ ।।
transliteration: sa samprahārastumulo māṁsaśoṇitakardamaḥ ।rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ ।। 6.42.47 ।।

translations.english: The conflict that happened between the Rakshasas and Vanaras was amazing and intense and left a mire of flesh and blood. ।। इत्यार्षेश्रीमद्वाल्मीकिरामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
